issues: 纯平灰底，网格与标题没有任何前后层次
图标位是 Unicode 符号（◆■▣），字体回退下粗细不一、像占位符
缩略图色块随机色相，粉棕橄榄混在一起显脏
卡片线性淡入 + outQuad 放大，没有落座感，阴影从头到尾一样
染色只是底色渐变，异常浮现缺少一个让眼睛被吸过去的瞬间；图例 Pending 无对应卡片
changes: 柔光 Backdrop + 中央白色柔光托底 + 输出像素级颗粒，全程 2.5% 平滑推近给画面呼吸
三类内容换成出版级：同色相浅底深字的首字母头像、白色矢量图标的渐变 App 图标、定调五套的双色风景缩略图
生长保持分环 stagger，scale 改为 overshoot 小幅落座（≈1.6%），阴影随落座从贴平抬到静置高度
染色一拍：底/边/点同曲线，卡片 1→1.045→1 轻顿，状态点一圈涟漪裁在卡片内；同时其余卡片退后 12%、缩略图降饱和
图例做成发丝线胶囊，Active/Pending/Inactive 计数随染色实时翻动（tabular-nums），新增 2 张琥珀 Pending 卡
issuesEn: Flat grey backdrop with no depth between the grid and the headline
Icon tiles were Unicode glyphs (◆■▣) with inconsistent weights from font fallback
Thumbnail blocks used random hues, producing a muddy pink/brown/olive mix
Cards faded in linearly with an outQuad scale and no settle; shadows never changed
The anomaly reveal was just a background tint with no moment that pulls the eye; the Pending legend item had no cards
changesEn: Soft-light Backdrop, a white halo behind the title, output-resolution grain and a slow 2.5% eased push-in
Publication-grade content: tinted initial avatars, gradient app icons with white vector glyphs, five curated duotone landscape thumbnails
Ring stagger kept; scale now settles with a small overshoot (~1.6%) and the shadow lifts from flat to resting height on landing
Colorize beat: bg/border/dot on one curve, a 1→1.045→1 tick, a single dot ripple clipped to the card, while other cards recede 12% and thumbnails desaturate
Legend became a hairline pill with live Active/Pending/Inactive counts (tabular-nums); two amber Pending cards added
